name: Start Date Change Pending Approval, Then Stale Employer Approval
description: FLP-2090 (Q6). SLD POSTs a draft apprenticeship, Commitments approves it, then SLD PUTs a new StartDate on the 13th, which the local Approvals stub answers EmployerApprovalRequested (pending). Both Learning and Earnings flag the episode FurtherApprovalNeeded and Earnings withholds payments. Approvals then publishes LearningChangeApprovedEvent for a start date of the 20th, which doesn't match the 13th Learning holds, so Learning drops the whole approval (fail closed): both flags stay set, nothing is echoed to Approvals, no EpisodeApprovedEvent is published and no on-programme payments are released. Nothing observable happens on a dropped approval, so the approval step waits 15s before the assertions. Bus messages are asserted from EventHub's ReceivedEvents, so EventHub must be running locally (the storybook checks before running).
